extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for Stanford's Office of University Communications on the goals and resources for institutional messaging — aimed at staff who produce or coordinate university communications (press releases, stories, campus messaging). Emphasizes supporting the university's work and reputation and using internal communicator resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support the work and reputation of the university
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of University Communications develops and executes strategies that support the work and reputation of the university.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop and execute communications strategies with the explicit aim of supporting Stanford's work and institutional reputation. (Page phrasing: 'develops and executes strategies that support the work and reputation of the university.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Share information and stories that inspire and influence
rubrics_metrics.description: We share information and stories about Stanford’s research breakthroughs, learning and discovery, campus life, and new ideas that help to inspire and influence a changing world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize content that highlights research breakthroughs, learning and discovery, campus life, and new ideas, with an emphasis on inspiring and influencing external and internal audiences. (Original phrasing preserved.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Use internal Communicator Resources (SUNet-required)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find internal information and shared resources to help you communicate more effectively and efficiently on this SUNet-required site: Communicator Resources website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staff should consult the SUNet 'Communicator Resources' site for required internal guidance and shared tools to ensure effective and efficient communications. The site is SUNet-required for Stanford communicators.
